name: Electronic Frontier Foundation
tagline: Defending civil liberties and user privacy in the digital world
description: The premier non-profit championing privacy, free expression, and innovation through litigation, technology development, and grassroots activism.
impactMetrics: Defending privacy and encryption rights for 4+ billion global internet users

name: Girls Who Code
tagline: Closing the gender gap in technology and computer science
description: On a mission to close the gender gap in tech. Reached over 500,000 young women through coding clubs, summer immersions, and university programs.
impactMetrics: 500,000+ students taught; alumni major in CS at 7x national average

name: Climate TRACE
tagline: Harnessing satellite data and AI to track global emissions in real time
description: A global coalition of non-profits and data scientists leveraging AI, remote sensing, and satellite telemetry to independently trace greenhouse gas emissions worldwide with facility-level precision.
impactMetrics: Tracking 352+ million emission assets worldwide with open data

name: Internet Archive
tagline: Universal access to all human knowledge and digital commons
description: A non-profit digital library offering free universal access to books, web pages, audio recordings, software, and cultural artifacts to researchers and the public.
impactMetrics: 830+ billion web pages preserved; free access for millions daily

name: TechSoup Global
tagline: Equipping non-profits and changemakers with transformative tech
description: Equips non-profits with technology solutions, hardware refurbishment, and software infrastructure to improve lives locally and worldwide.
impactMetrics: $18+ billion in hardware and software delivered to 1.4M organizations

name: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team
tagline: Open-source geospatial mapping for humanitarian disaster response
description: Mobilizes a global community of volunteer technologists and GIS specialists to map disaster-struck regions from satellite data for first responders.
impactMetrics: 350,000+ volunteer mappers assisting first responders in 100+ countries

name: Black Girls CODE
tagline: Empowering young women of color to become future technology leaders
description: Creating pathways for young women of color in AI, robotics, web development, and computing through rigorous workshops, hackathons, and corporate mentorship.
impactMetrics: 100,000+ students across 15 national chapters and virtual bootcamps

name: freeCodeCamp
tagline: Free, open-source computer science curriculum for anyone worldwide
description: A donor-supported charity providing an open-access, full-stack programming curriculum that has helped tens of thousands of people transition into software careers.
impactMetrics: 10,000+ free coding lessons; 40k+ verified developer career transitions

name: Web Accessibility Initiative
tagline: Standardizing digital accessibility and assistive technologies
description: Sets the global WCAG standards and authors open-source tools to make software, browsers, and digital interfaces fully operable by people of all physical and cognitive abilities.
impactMetrics: Authored the WCAG standards powering over 1 billion accessible web pages
